payload.answer_summary: Per the July 30, 2025 FOMC statement: the Committee maintained the federal funds target range at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent [ref-1: 'maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent']. Dissenters were Michelle W. Bowman and Christopher J. Waller, whose stated preference was to lower the target range by 1/4 percentage point at this meeting [ref-1]. One uncertainty relevant to the policy path: 'Uncertainty about the economic outlook remains elevated,' which the Committee weighs in assessing 'the extent and timing of additional adjustments' [ref-1]. The dissenters' stated preference (a 25bp cut) is evidence; any inferred motive (e.g., why they preferred a cut) is not supported by the supplied text.
